welle_e2.sperre.verwaltung: Reserve {vorrat}, {bedarf} needed. {laufend} running projects tie up {bau} administrative capacity a month; {ohne} of them are making no progress.
welle_e2.wb.keinerStartbar: No project can start right now. What is missing is listed below.
welle_e2.wb.planTip: At today's pace ×{tempo}. Planned build time: {plan} months.
welle_e2.rat.titel: The research council makes its proposals
welle_e2.rat.text1: {wer}: The research council recommends projects that can start now. {laufend, plural, =0 {No project is running} one {One project is running} other {# projects are running}} in the knowledge tree; the pace is ×{tempo}.
welle_e2.rat.text2: A licence is faster but creates dependence: if the licensor cuts supply, the project stalls. That is what happened to the Altay tank and its German engine.
welle_e2.rat.warum: {laufend, plural, =0 {No project is running} one {Only one project is running} other {# projects are running}} in the knowledge tree. The council reports when there is room for research.
welle_e2.rat.lizenzFolge: Pace ×{tempo}. If {land} cuts supply, it drops to ×{gesperrt}. Annoyed: {rivalen}.
welle_e2.rat.standard: The council gets no answer. The industry minister sees research left lying: loyalty −{d}.
welle_e2.rat.opt.abwarten.label: Start nothing for now
welle_e2.rat.opt.abwarten.beschr: The council will report again next year.
welle_e2.rat.opt.abwarten.ausgang: You start no new project. The council will report again later.
welle_e2.vw.titel: {n, plural, one {One research project is} other {# research projects are}} waiting for the administration
welle_e2.vw.text1: {wer}: {name} could start, but the administration has no reserve (level {vorrat}, balance {netto} a month).
welle_e2.vw.text2: {laufend} projects tie up administrative capacity; {ohne} of them are making no progress because building capacity is short. If they are paused, the capacity is left for research.
welle_e2.vw.warum: A new project needs three times its monthly requirement as a reserve. {n, plural, one {One node is} other {# nodes are}} waiting only for that.
welle_e2.vw.opt.ruhen.label: {n, plural, =0 {No stalled project to pause} one {Pause one stalled project} other {Pause # stalled projects}}
welle_e2.vw.opt.ruhen.beschr: They are paused on the building site and can be resumed there at any time.
welle_e2.vw.opt.ruhen.ausgang: {n} projects paused. {frei} administrative capacity a month is freed.
welle_e2.vw.opt.ruhen.frei: +{frei} administrative capacity a month; balance afterwards {netto}.
welle_e2.vw.opt.ruhen.monate: At today's balance, research can start in about {n, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}.
welle_e2.vw.opt.ruhen.nie: Even then the administration falls short: more staff or less building is needed.
welle_e2.vw.opt.abwarten.label: Building comes first
welle_e2.vw.opt.abwarten.beschr: Research waits until running projects are finished.
welle_e2.vw.standard: Nobody decides. Research keeps waiting, and the industry minister loses patience: loyalty −{d}.
welle_e2.gz.text1: {wer}: The signs are favourable for “{stufe}” ({ziel}). The chance is {wort}, about {von} to {bis} %.
welle_e2.gz.warum: The stage can be attempted, and the chance is at least promising. Opportunities like this do not wait for ever.
welle_e2.gz.opt.wagen.label: Attempt it now
welle_e2.gz.opt.wagen.beschr: The attempt decides: success, partial success or failure.
welle_e2.gz.opt.wagen.teil: Partial success: half the effect, the stage counts as watered down
welle_e2.gz.opt.vorbereiten.gipfel: Prepare first: summit with the partners
welle_e2.gz.opt.vorbereiten.beschr: The chance of the next attempt rises. Preparation fades over time.
welle_e2.gz.opt.spaeter.label: Later
welle_e2.gz.opt.spaeter.beschr: The stage stays among the deadlines on the desk.
welle_e2.gz.opt.spaeter.ausgang: You wait. The stage stays on the desk.
welle_e2.gz.standard: The opportunity passes. The partners in “{ziel}” notice the hesitation: trust −{v}, preparation −{p} points.
